statement.text: Schinzel's hypothesis H that for every finite collection $\{f_{1},\ldots ,f_{k}\}$ of nonconstant irreducible polynomials over the integers with positive leading coefficients, either there are infinitely many positive integers $n$ for which $f_{1}(n),\ldots ,f_{k}(n)$ are all primes , or there is some fixed divisor $m>1$ which, for all $n$ , divides some $f_{i}(n)$ .

title: Schinzel's hypothesis H
